description: Good and useful to all students 👍
summary: The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive STEM game and simulation app designed for kids (ages 7–12) to manage a lunar or Martian outpost while balancing real engineering trade-offs like life support, power budgets, radiation shielding, and food production.
